entry_conditions: Drawer_position is above 0.26 and stable, target_pose denotes the open drawer destination, object_pose is finite and low in or near the tunnel, and the gripper is open and free of the handle at normal entry. A mid-skill entry should have object/TCP/finger geometry consistent with approach, extraction or lift; closed fingers alone do not prove a grasp.
exit_conditions: The observed block is outside the tunnel footprint with its bottom above the 0.16 m roof, fingers remain closed, object and TCP motion remain coupled, and destination-directed transfer has begun while the drawer remains open.
overlap_role: Every action in [300,840) is supervised. The [300,440) predecessor overlap supplies 140 actions for post-open retreat and approach starts; [680,840) supplies 160 actions shared with placement for final lift, reorientation and early transfer.
successor_readiness: Hand off to placement during [680,840) after block-bottom clearance is positive, the destination blend weight is high, closed-finger object/TCP coupling persists, and motion has turned toward target_pose. A high blend weight or closed fingers alone is insufficient.
failure_signatures: Large disagreement between reconstructed object and destination candidates, destination-directed motion while the block remains below the roof, closed fingers without object/TCP coupling, failure to extract or lift, a dropped block, drawer movement below the open threshold, or persistent IK nonconvergence/limit contact.
continuation_guidance: Continue block-anchored approach, grasp, negative-x extraction and lift while the block bottom is below the roof; then allow the analytic blend to move control toward the destination branch. Prefer existing h02 for a major valid TCP/configuration mismatch with a near-nominal block, and h03 when its conservative low-clearance transfer guard is required.
limitations: The displacement benefit and branch blend have no out-of-distribution validation. Object height and target_pose must be reliable. No contact truth or failed-grasp examples support retry, and the representation cannot guarantee collision freedom, reachability or stable grasping.
